questions.explanation: $2^5 = 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 \times 2 = 32$. A common error is to multiply the base by the index ($2 \times 5 = 10$), but powers mean repeated multiplication.
$(-3)^3 = (-3) \times (-3) \times (-3) = -27$, so $\sqrt[3]{-27} = -3$. Unlike square roots, cube roots of negative numbers are defined.
Any non-zero number raised to the power of 0 equals 1. So $7^0 = 1$.

questions.stem: Between which two consecutive integers does $\sqrt{70}$ lie?
questions.explanation: $8^2 = 64$ and $9^2 = 81$. Since $64 < 70 < 81$, we know $\sqrt{70}$ lies between 8 and 9.

questions.stem: A square has area $196 \text{ cm}^2$. What is its side length?
questions.explanation: For a square, area $= \text{side}^2$. So side $= \sqrt{196} = 14$ cm.

questions.stem: Which statement about powers of negative numbers is correct?

options.text: A negative number raised to any power is always negative
A negative number raised to an even power is positive; raised to an odd power is negative
A negative number raised to an even power is negative; raised to an odd power is positive
A negative number can never be raised to a power

questions.explanation: An even power of a negative number is positive (e.g., $(-3)^2 = 9$) because the pairs of negatives cancel. An odd power is negative (e.g., $(-3)^3 = -27$) because there is one unpaired negative.
